description: A Report on Validation and Mesh Sensitivity Analysis of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Models is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Jamie Padgett, Rice University (rice.edu). This document details the validation and mesh sensitivity analyses of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) models used to estimate hydraulic pressure around aboveground storage tanks (ASTs) subjected to storm surge and wave loads. The validation study is based on experimental results from Bernier et al. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-f69h-5f03. Keywords: computational fluid dynamics, neighboring structures, aboveground storage tanks. Published 2026-03-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
